description: A painterly, dark laboratory bench scene. Two glass petri dishes sit in the foreground: the left one holds smooth, glossy, rounded colonies in amber liquid, the right one holds rough, grainy clumps. On the right, a grey mouse sits in a wire mesh cage, beside a syringe and a rack holding a test tube of amber liquid. Glass flasks on retort stands and bottles line the dim background, with wisps of steam or smoke rising through the middle. No visible text, no frame, no people, no blood.
